To follow the progress of the procedure, please use this link: https://unical.portaleamministrazionetrasparente.it/index.php?id_oggetto=22&id_doc=33133 As part of the Erasmus+ Programme, the University of Calabria participates and promotes Short Term Mobility to consolidate international collaborations between universities and companies, creating new opportunities for cultural, economic and academic exchange and stimulating the development of new knowledge and skills. Short-term Mobility combines a short-term EU and extra-EU physical mobility component (5-30 consecutive and full days) with a compulsory virtual training period during the academic year of the call to enable the acquisition of at least 3 ECTS. Short-term mobility initiatives are usually co-organized by the Internationalization Area with the Departments and offer scholarships and facilities for educational activities related to the various Programmes. All information is published in the ‘News’ (Bandi e Avvisi) on the University portal and on the websites of participating Programmes.
